clustering_reward_shaping: train_env only when use_clustering_in_config is true

end.summary: Primary report metric (test split, after training).
end.definition: Mean applicable jobs per learner on the held-out test split after the RL policy recommends k courses. Raw reward (no clustering shaping). This is the main metric for CLIRS vs baseline comparisons.
end.when: once per trial, after model.learn() completes

life.summary: Training proxy (train split, last callback log).
life.definition: Mean applicable jobs on the train split at the final EvaluateCallback checkpoint: the second column of the last line in raw/*_training.txt (training steps, mean jobs, elapsed time). Reflects in-training progress on train learners — not generalization.
life.when: end of training log; do not use as the primary conclusion metric

original_applicable_jobs.definition: Mean applicable jobs on the test split using each learner's profile before the policy recommends courses.
